author: Good Enough
description:
Gliese 436 b is one of the strangest planets ever discovered, a world where “hot ice” can exist under extreme pressure. Despite temperatures hot enough to normally vaporize water, the crushing pressure inside this Neptune-sized exoplanet may force water into exotic high-pressure forms instead.

Gliese 436 b orbits extremely close to its star and experiences intense heat, making it a bizarre combination of scorching temperatures and unusual planetary chemistry. If a human somehow reached this world, the heat, pressure, and violent conditions would make survival essentially impossible.

This Short explores Gliese 436 b, hot ice, extreme exoplanets, alien worlds, and some of the strangest conditions found beyond our solar system.
title: This Planet is Covered in Hot Ice 🧊🔥 #didyouknow #astronomy #spacefacts #space
